title: cynosurus cristatus f. tenuissimus
intro: Cynosurus cristatus f. tenuissimus, commonly known as Thin Couch-grass, is a variant of the Cynosurus cristatus plant, a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to reduce water retention and alleviate symptoms associated with urinary tract infections. The therapeutic actions of Thin Couch-grass include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating wounds and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
